documents.name: shippers
documents.text: Shippers. Shipping companies. Carriers. Couriers. Delivery companies. Freight companies. Logistics providers. Transport companies. Who delivers our orders. Contains the shipper identifier, the shipping company name and its phone number.
Shipper ID. Shipper identifier. Carrier code. Courier ID. Shipping company number. The number that uniquely identifies a shipping company. Used to link an order to the shipper that carried it.
Shipper company name. Shipper name. Carrier name. Courier name. Delivery company name. Name of the shipping company. Which carrier delivered an order.
Shipper phone. Phone number. Telephone number. Contact number of the shipping company. How to call the carrier.
